title: Monoallelic variants in BRSK1 are associated with a neurodevelopmental disorder with or without epilepsy.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: no PMCID, not open access in Europe PMC, no supplement listing, no text-mined accessions, no NCBI links (GEO/SRA/dbGaP), no Zenodo/Dryad hits on the DOI. No data files exist to open.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Abstract only: 10 individuals with heterozygous BRSK1 variants (1 from the Texome Project, 9 via GeneMatcher, a researcher matchmaking service), and fly (Drosophila) rescue experiments testing 3 missense variants.

a1_downloadable.note: No deposited dataset found; paper is paywalled with no PMC copy. Patient-level genomic data would be clinical and not public.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No table available; per-variant functional labels exist only as figure results for 3 variants (paper text only).

a5_enough_rows.note: Abstract describes 10 individuals and 3 functionally tested variants, far below the 400-row minimum.

a8_label_provenance.note: Fly rescue assays are physical measurements, but cover only 3 variants (paper text only).

honest_claim_h3: No model claim is possible: 10 patients and 3 tested variants give nothing to train on.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use BRSK1 protein variant sequences to predict whether each variant loses function in a fly rescue test.
plain_idea.train_on: Missense variants in BRSK1, a brain kinase gene; only 3 were functionally tested (paper text only), so effectively unknown/insufficient.
plain_idea.predict: Partial versus full rescue of fly locomotor and neuromuscular-junction defects when the human variant is expressed in sff-null flies.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would help clinical geneticists classify new BRSK1 variants, but 3 labelled variants cannot support any model.

ml_idea: None viable: a 10-patient case series with 3 fly-tested variants; at most a positive-control datapoint for general variant-effect predictors.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Check for any deposited data: none found in Europe PMC, NCBI, Zenodo or Dryad.

verdict_reason: Gene-discovery case series (10 individuals, 3 fly-tested variants) with no deposited, downloadable data; fails A1 and A5.
